Data.subject: Labour, Employment, Wages and Productivity
Data.title: Active Central Provident Fund Members By Age Group (End Of Period), Annual
Data.footnote: Refers to persons who have at least one contribution paid for them for the current or any of the preceding three months.  From 1992, data exclude self-employed persons who are not employees concurrently.

row.footnote: Prior to 2019, age group 'Up to 20' includes members between ages 13 to 20.  From 2019 onwards, age groups are based on actual ages (i.e., from 0 to 20).
